physics_goals.quote: SLAC-SP-032 built the MARK-III detector designed to collect data on particles known to be produced at SPEAR: D meson, psi, and psi-prime physics.
physics_goals.value: Collect data on particles produced at SPEAR: D meson, psi and psi-prime physics

summary.plain: The third general-purpose detector at SLAC's SPEAR ring, run from 1981 to 1988 by a collaboration of Caltech, SLAC, Santa Cruz, Illinois and Washington. It was built to collect large samples of D mesons, J/psi and psi-prime decays.
summary.technical: Mark III at SPEAR: general-purpose detector designed to collect data on particles known to be produced at SPEAR: D meson, ψ and ψ′ physics (AIP catalogue); work begun 1978, checkout 1980, installed 1981, experimental program ended 1988, dismantling begun 1998. Collaboration of Caltech, SLAC, UC Santa Cruz, Illinois and Washington.
